data.description: Investor directive 2026-08-29 (recorded in CLAUDE.md ## Infra): all local apps run via Docker / Docker Compose — no code runs bare on the host. Apply to apps/chat (the only app so far): compose file to build/run the server (loopback-only exposure preserved), persistent volume or bind mount for the SQLite data dir, read access to .lattice/ for event ingestion, and a containerized path for BOTH the test suite and the agent-facing chat CLI (agents must invoke it without running node on the host — e.g. docker compose run/exec wrapper). Update apps/chat README run instructions accordingly. Constraints: official images only, no registries requiring accounts/spend, no egress beyond image pulls, do not touch existing GitHub repos or DO services. Forward-looking: this compose setup should be the template for eventual DO hosting per CLAUDE.md Infra.
data.title: Containerize chat app: docker compose is the only way code runs

data.body: Plan written to plans/task_01M185YRZNXS1MGAMMNH5VP0YN.md. Key calls: one image off official node:24-slim (no third-party registries; tests COPY'd in so the test service exercises the exact shipped bits), three compose services from it — server, cli (profile: tools), test (profile: tools, zero mounts). Loopback exposure survives containerization by moving enforcement to the host side of the port map (127.0.0.1:8347:8347) while the server binds 0.0.0.0 only inside; app default stays loopback. chat.db stays a bind mount at apps/chat/data (zero migration, host sqlite3/backup ergonomics; named-volume perf is a DO concern, not a laptop concern); .lattice mounts read-only at /repo with CHAT_REPO_ROOT baked in. Agent CLI becomes ./apps/chat/chat — a wrapper around docker compose run --rm --build -T with CHAT_ME env passthrough, verbatim args, and exit-code propagation; --build on every one-off run is the defense against stale COPY'd images. Canonical test invocation: docker compose run --rm --build test. README loses ALL bare-node instructions per the directive. Ten acceptance criteria including lsof/inspect loopback verification, down/up persistence, idempotent ingestion from in-container, and an AS-2 AC spot-walk; five recorded DO-deployment notes (auth is a hard blocker before any non-localhost exposure). Marcus executes cold; Priya reviews. —Owen

M1-M3 done (Marcus). Image node:24-slim builds; compose server/cli/test wired; wrapper contract passes all four parts; tests 22/22 in-container with zero mounts (2.8s incl. rebuild check); loopback verified (inspect=127.0.0.1, lsof loopback-only, LAN curl refused); durability across restart AND down/up; ingestion idempotent in-container, fresh AS-2/AS-3/AS-4 events landed in #lattice-events. Two environment findings + boring fixes, both in committed comments: (1) host ~/.zshrc exports DOCKER_BUILDKIT=0 COMPOSE_DOCKER_CLI_BUILD=0 DOCKER_DEFAULT_PLATFORM=linux/amd64 — the legacy-builder path ignores ALL compose platform settings at build, builds native arm64, then create refuses against amd64, so raw 'docker compose up' breaks in any login shell. Fix: platform: linux/amd64 pinned on all three services (deterministic + DO-shaped per plan §7) and every sanctioned invocation forces DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 COMPOSE_DOCKER_CLI_BUILD=1 (wrapper exports them; README commands carry the prefix). (2) Plan §8 risk 1 materialized: non-TTY BuildKit progress writes to stdout and corrupted --json; fixed with --progress quiet in the wrapper per the plan's own fallback. No EACCES under USER node (Desktop maps bind-mount ownership, as Owen predicted). README rewrite next.

Implementation complete (Marcus). Commit 4167f2c on master (deviation on orchestrator's orders: master, not feat/AS-4-containerize). Files: apps/chat/{Dockerfile,.dockerignore,compose.yaml,chat,README.md}; app code untouched per plan §0. All ten ACs walked: C1 up --build serves UI at 127.0.0.1:8347 with pre-existing AS-2 data intact (same DB file, bind mount); C2 loopback three ways (inspect HostIp=127.0.0.1, lsof loopback-only listener, LAN-IP curl refused); C3 CLI works with server container stopped AND running (WAL across containers over the bind mount); C4 wrapper contract 4/4 (args verbatim, CHAT_ME passthrough, exit codes 0/1, --json|jq clean after --progress quiet fix); C5 in-container ingestion idempotent, fresh AS-2-done/AS-3/AS-4 events landed in #lattice-events; C6 data+read-state survive restart and down+up; C7 22/22 in-container with zero mounts; C8 spot-walked (DM round-trip, thread reply via wrapper, AS-n resolution through the ro mount); C9 README has zero bare-node paths; C10 only egress is the node:24-slim pull, package.json deps still absent. Server container left running (restart: unless-stopped) as the company chat service. For Priya: cold-run the README commands in a FRESH login shell (the BuildKit-forcing prefix is the load-bearing bit — raw 'docker compose up' without it reproduces the platform mismatch, documented in README troubleshooting note); re-walk Carla AC1-AC10 in a real browser against the container; healthcheck shows healthy. Moving to review.

REVIEW (Priya, cold context — inputs: Owen's plan, Marcus's two milestone comments, commit 4167f2c). VERDICT: PASS.

Commit hygiene PASS: 4167f2c contains exactly the five planned files (Dockerfile, .dockerignore, compose.yaml, chat, README.md), all under apps/chat/; app code, package.json (deps still absent), CLAUDE.md, .lattice/, personnel untouched. Master-not-branch was orchestrator-directed; outcome clean. Unrelated commit 843b022 and other agents' files left alone.

1) FRESH-LOGIN-SHELL COLD RUN — confirmed and reproduced. ~/.zshrc lines 135-137 export DOCKER_BUILDKIT=0, COMPOSE_DOCKER_CLI_BUILD=0, DOCKER_DEFAULT_PLATFORM=linux/amd64 (verified via zsh -l). Raw 'docker compose run --rm --build cli' in a fresh login shell WITHOUT the prefix: legacy builder builds arm64, create refuses — daemon error 'platform (linux/arm64/v8) does not match the specified platform (linux/amd64)', exit 1, matching the README troubleshooting quote verbatim. The documented prefix path and the wrapper both succeed from a fresh login shell, and the wrapper's forced BuildKit + --build HEALS the stale arm64 tag the raw failure leaves behind (verified in sequence). The prefix is load-bearing exactly as documented.

2) CARLA AC1-AC10 REGRESSION WALK (independent, against the container, live data — QA traffic isolated to new #qa-verification channel + clearly-labeled agent:qa-fixture identity; no colleague's words fabricated, no colleague's read-state touched): AC1 history intact (AS-2-era messages served, e.g. engineering #12); AC2 create-channel + attributed/timestamped post OK; AC3 DM lands in recipient inbox as new; AC4 wrapper post byte-identical via API (quotes/angles/unicode); AC5 reply-to-reply flattens to root (35→30), never top-level; AC6 catchup → 'Nothing new.' exit 0, then exactly 1 channel + 1 DM + 1 thread reply = exactly 3, own posts excluded; AC7 AS-4 resolves to live title+status through the ro mount in CLI, wrapper --json, and /api/task; AC8/C5 fresh real events (AS-2 done, AS-3 created, AS-4 lifecycle) ingested in-container, 'chat sync' x2 → posted 0,0; AC9/C6 below; AC10/C10 below. lattice-events carve-out: top-level as agent → exit 1 with actionable stderr message; thread reply allowed. No regression found.

3) PLATFORM PIN JUDGMENT — justified. Image arch amd64, uname in-container x86_64 (emulated on this Mac). Measured cost: full 22-test suite 1.38s in-container, 2.5s wall including rebuild check (Marcus's 2.8s claim confirmed, slightly better today); CLI round-trip ~1-2s. Determinism benefit is not theoretical on this host — DOCKER_DEFAULT_PLATFORM=linux/amd64 in the login shell means an UNpinned build's arch would depend on which shell built it; the pin plus forced BuildKit is the only configuration that behaves identically everywhere, and it matches the DO target (plan §7). Right call.

4) HYGIENE PASS: C7 tests 22/22 in-container via documented command, test service mounts zero volumes (compose.yaml confirms; passing with no mounts = no state leak). C2 loopback three ways: inspect PortBindings HostIp=127.0.0.1; lsof shows single listener 127.0.0.1:8347; curl to LAN IP 192.168.1.231:8347 connection refused; loopback 200. C6 durability: marker message + unread snapshot [31,32,33] identical across 'compose restart' AND full down+up (bind mount, same DB file, backup dump 61 valid JSONL lines taken first). C3: CLI worked with the server container stopped and running (WAL across containers). .lattice/ ro mount kernel-enforced: touch and rm inside the cli container both fail 'Read-only file system'. Wrapper contract 4/4 re-verified: args verbatim incl. unicode; CHAT_ME passthrough (no --me); exit codes 0/1 propagate ('frobnicate' → 1, clean inbox → 0); --json stdout parses clean (dump piped straight into json.loads, 0 bad lines).

C9 PASS: grep finds zero bare-node invocations in README; only the history note. C10 PASS: FROM node:24-slim is the only image reference (official library), no npm install in Dockerfile, deps/devDeps absent.

Non-blocking observations (violate no criterion): (a) a raw un-prefixed run leaves a stale arm64 image tag — self-healing on next sanctioned invocation, and the README note covers the symptom; (b) QA fixture identity agent:qa-fixture and #qa-verification now exist in the live store as reusable, clearly-labeled review fixtures. No inline fixes needed — zero files changed by review.

Server container left RUNNING and HEALTHY (docker inspect: running, health=healthy) with all company data intact. Meets acceptance criteria; moving to done.
